entries.symptom: maestro fails to start: Unable to locate a Java Runtime, or JAVA_HOME is not set
entries.cause: Maestro needs Java 17
entries.fix: Point JAVA_HOME at a JDK 17 for the process (/usr/libexec/java_home -v 17 on macOS, or Android Studio's bundled runtime); installing a JDK is a human step
match: Unable to locate a Java Runtime

entries.symptom: setAirplaneMode does nothing on the iOS simulator
entries.cause: iOS simulators have no airplane mode (the command works only on Android)
entries.fix: Simulate offline through the app's connectivity port (a debug link or test hook that fakes offline); keep setAirplaneMode only in Android-only flows

entries.symptom: A flow uses assertWithAI, assertNoDefectsWithAI or extractTextWithAI
entries.cause: They upload screenshots to a third-party service and are not deterministic
entries.fix: Assert testIDs and texts; look at the screenshots yourself

entries.symptom: A Maestro command sent the run off the machine (test --analyze, cloud, login, record without --local)
entries.cause: Those commands upload screens or results to a cloud service
entries.fix: Never use them in the repo tooling; the flow checker reports them

entries.symptom: maestro test --tags is rejected
entries.cause: Maestro 2.10 has --include-tags and --exclude-tags, no --tags
entries.fix: Use --include-tags / --exclude-tags

entries.symptom: Flows in sub-folders do not run
entries.cause: maestro test <folder> does not recurse into sub-folders
entries.fix: List the flow files explicitly (the runner does), flows in .maestro/flows/<suite>/<nn>-<name>.yaml

entries.symptom: maestro check-syntax prints "Parsing Failed at <line>:<col>" on an evalScript line that holds a ternary (cond ? a : b)
entries.cause: A ": " inside a plain YAML scalar starts a mapping, so the flow is not valid YAML
entries.fix: Quote the whole scalar or write the choice as arithmetic; never an unquoted ": " in evalScript

entries.symptom: A screenshot step waits and fails on a screen whose root testID differs from its name
entries.cause: The sub-flow waited for ${SCREEN}.screen while that screen renders another root
entries.fix: Pass the screen's root testID to the sub-flow explicitly

entries.symptom: Element not found: Text matching regex: Open (a guard matched the wrong element first)
entries.cause: Maestro's text match ignores case and matches any visible text, so a guard such as when visible: 'Open' matched an ad's OPEN button
entries.fix: Match the exact system alert ("Open in .*\?") or a testID, and make the tap after a guard optional
match: Element not found: Text matching regex

entries.symptom: maestro hierarchy misses testIDs
entries.cause: It lists only on-screen elements, hides children of accessible elements, and rounds bounds to whole points
entries.fix: Put testIDs on the accessible element (the Pressable), scroll to the element first, allow 1 pt

entries.symptom: A permission or tracking prompt never appears in a flow, or the status already reads granted
entries.cause: launchApp grants every permission by default (the iOS tracking answer included)
entries.fix: Launch with permissions: { all: unset } in flows that test a prompt, or install fresh and launch with xcrun simctl launch / adb -s <serial> shell am start

entries.symptom: A debug link right after launchApp clearState is ignored (no language, data or screen applied), while the same link seconds later works
entries.cause: The app was launched without the URL and its JS had not started the link handler yet, so neither getInitialURL nor the url event delivered it
entries.fix: Start listening as early as the debug kit loads and queue links until the navigator is ready; the setup sub-flow waits for the first screen root before openLink. Never add a fixed sleep

entries.symptom: maestro hierarchy shows another screen or language, or the run answers with another session's app
entries.cause: Maestro reached another session's device: the call named no --device, or two sessions' drivers shared a port
entries.fix: Name the device on every call: maestro --device <udid or serial> --driver-host-port <own port> <command> (maestroGlobalArgs()); simctl by UDID, adb -s <serial>

entries.symptom: A Maestro run fails to connect to its driver (port 7001 in use, Failed to connect)
entries.cause: The call used the default driver port, which another session's driver on the same machine already listens on
entries.fix: Give every run its own --driver-host-port (the maestro-args helper picks a free one)

entries.symptom: UnknownFailure(errorResponse=Request for viewHierarchy failed, code: 500), then the Maestro process stays alive and the runner waits for ever
entries.cause: The iOS driver could not answer a hierarchy request on an overloaded machine; Maestro's main thread died but its JVM kept running
entries.fix: Stop that Maestro process only (it names your device and port), wait until the load average is below twice the cores, rerun; run screenshot matrices alone, never beside a Release build

entries.symptom: A memory or footprint step after the flows finds no app process
entries.cause: Maestro 2.10 stops the app when a test ends
entries.fix: Relaunch the app by UDID or serial after the flows, wait for its pid, then measure

entries.symptom: Flows time out at random steps (relaunches never answer, StoreKit or system sheets appear late)
entries.cause: The machine is overloaded (load average far above the core count), so a correct app times out
entries.fix: Rerun alone once the load average is below twice the cores; never raise every timeout

entries.symptom: The runtime network check reports sockets the app never opens, while every flow passes
entries.cause: The sampler watched every process with the app's name on the machine, another session's copy included
entries.fix: Sample only the processes of your own simulator or emulator (by UDID or serial)

entries.symptom: A Debug test build fails most flows at once and LogBox covers the app: a blocked websocket or fetch to localhost:8081
entries.cause: The test build's network guard blocked the Debug build's own Metro (the bundle and the HMR websocket)
entries.fix: Let only a __DEV__ build reach localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1]; a Release build still blocks everything

entries.symptom: A flow taps a test ad's close key, but the ad stays on screen ("Test mode" still visible)
entries.cause: Google's test full-screen ads ignore a close tap until the key is ready
entries.fix: Tap the close key again while "Test mode" is still visible (runFlow when visible), then assert the app

entries.symptom: A Debug Android build on the emulator shows "Unable to load script" or cannot reach Metro
entries.cause: The emulator reaches the machine at 10.0.2.2, not localhost, unless the port is reversed
entries.fix: adb -s <serial> reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081, or test a Release build (the evidence build is Release)
